verdict.rationale: AngelList is a fund-administration and cap-table SaaS that already ships AI features (the Tie Out Assistant), so an MCP-client connector for its assistant is a conceivable capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions the product consuming external MCP servers or tools. Its only integrations are HRIS/payroll connectors, and the probes found just an llms.txt file and no API spec, so there is no evidence it delivers this story.
